title: How to Laravel series: What is new in Laravel 4.1
content:
<html><head></head><body>So big news today. Taylor Otwell just released Laravel 4.1! We all have been looking forward to this new version and I can tell you it was worth the little delay. Additionally the official Laravel site got a big update and a new look.  These are really good news and I will give you a short overview of what is new in Laravel 4.1 in this article.
            </body></html>
author: Christoph Rumpel Blog Feed
